messages:
elaine: Heads up - new user hit a confusing onboarding flow. They used the CLI sample with a service account created before workspace billing was accepted. CLI printed 'request sent' then hung, then later returned a success but no text. They attached logs.

ravi: can you paste the CLI output + sdk version?

elaine: CLI stdout:
```
$ ./hello_cli --key sa-XXXX
sending request to model=open-7b
request sent
waiting for stream...
stream closed
request finished
```
SDK: go-sdk v0.6.2, sample unmodified from docs.

ravi: odd. 'stream closed' then 'request finished' suggests the SDK saw connection close and treated that as end-of-stream, but no chunks were produced. Do we have the raw HTTP body?

elaine: user pasted curl (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer sa-XXXX
Content-Type: application/json

{"model":"open-7b","input":"hi"}
```
response: HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
content-type: application/json

body:
{"error":{"code":403,"type":"forbidden","message":"Service account not allowed until workspace billing accepted","meta":{"next_step":"billing_ack_required"}}}

then SDK retried once (network retry middleware) and got:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
content-type: application/json

{"id":"r_77","status":"partial","detail":"billing_preview_only","message":"Preview-only: accept billing to generate","streaming":false}

connection reset. Dashboard shows two attempts and a small token footprint. User worried about being charged.

ops-bot: Noting: some older service accounts get 403 until org billing is accepted. We also recently changed preview behavior to emit a 200 preview body for trial workspaces which is causing SDKs to mis-handle state.

ravi: immediate takeaways: (1) SDKs should not retry on 4xx error responses (2) SDKs must detect gating sentinel bodies (detail==billing_preview_only or meta.next_step==billing_ack_required) and raise explicit errors, not return silent success.

billing-bot: Clarification: preview attempts are recorded as "preview footprint" for quota and debugging; we do not invoice preview attempts. However quick dashboard views aggregate attempts and can look like usage. We'll add an explicit label and tooltip.

elaine: workaround for users: accept billing invite (workspace admin) or create a new workspace that already has billing enabled. For internal testing, use org-internal tokens that bypass preview gating.

ravi: I'll open patches: go-sdk@0.6.3 to change retry policy (don't retry on 4xx), add sentinel detection in streaming path and raise a descriptive error with link to onboarding FAQ. Also add tests that mock 403 then 200-preview and ensure SDK surfaces single clear error instead of double-attempt logs. Ticket DX-9001.

ops-bot: INF-4700 filed to standardize server behavior: prefer 402/403 consistently for gating and avoid 200-with-detail for preview mode; or add X-Gating-Reason header so SDKs can reliably detect.

elaine: customer accepted billing and retried: streaming returned text immediately. :party-parrot:

devex-bot: release note: go-sdk@0.6.3 published - avoids retrying on client errors, surfaces billing-gating errors in streaming path.

ravi: followups: (A) docs: add small onboarding note in quickstart 'Billing may block first call; if you see no text, confirm workspace billing state' (B) CS playbook blurb + canned response (C) add CI test that simulates 200-with-gating-body so samples never print 'request finished' without content.

elaine: thanks all — closing after docs + CI test merged.
